:::{#sol-matrix-row-practice}

$\matr{D}$ has $n = 3$ [column](#def-matrix-column)s,
so its third [row](#def-matrix-row) holds the three entries $d_{31}$, $d_{32}$ and $d_{33}$:

$$
\matr{D}_{3,:} = \begin{bmatrix} d_{31} & d_{32} & d_{33} \end{bmatrix}
= \begin{bmatrix} 5 & 5 & -1 \end{bmatrix}.
$$

:::
